name: Eastern Bow
description: →Perform a bow in the Far Eastern fashion.

name: Serpent Salute
description: →Perform an official Order of the Twin Adder salute.

name: Eastern Greeting
description: ALIASES: /easterngreeting, /egreeting USAGE: /egreeting [subcommand] →Perform a greeting common in the Far East.

name: Pray
description: →Offer solemn words of prayer to the Twelve or whatever gods it is you keep.

name: Hand to Heart
description: →Gently place your hand on your heart.

name: Blow Kiss
description: →Throw an airborne smooch in someone's general direction.

name: Dote
description: →Throw a heartfelt kiss at your beloved.

name: Pet
description: →Take the love within your heart and focus it into your hand.

name: Gratuity
description: →Humbly scatter gold coins at the feet of your admirers.

name: Fist Pump
description: →Express an unbridled satisfaction at the crushing defeat of your enemies via a swift pumping motion of your arms.

name: Senor Sabotender
description: →Do your finest impression of the Manderville Gold Saucer's mascot Senor Sabotender.

name: Toast
description: →Raise a toast to those around you.

name: Flower Shower
description: ALIASES: /flowershower, /petals USAGE: /flowershower [subcommand] →Toss fragrant flower petals into the air.

name: All Saints' Charm
description: →Swish and flick to cast a spell.

name: Victory Reveal
description: ALIASES: /victoryreveal, /vreveal USAGE: /victoryreveal [subcommand] →Await news of your victory.

name: Humble Triumph
description: ALIASES: /humbletriumph, /waitforit USAGE: /humbletriumph [subcommand] →Strike a mildly triumphant pose.

name: Uchiwasshoi
description: ALIASES: /uchiwasshoi, /bigfan USAGE: /uchiwasshoi [subcommand] →Stir the air with a giant fan.

name: Breaking
description: ALIASES: /breakdance, /breaking USAGE: /breakdance [subcommand] →Perform a stylish and powerful dance.

name: Limber Up
description: ALIASES: /limberup, /limber USAGE: /limberup [subcommand] →Wind up your arm in a brisk stretch.

name: Delighted
description: ALIASES: /delighted, /delight USAGE: /delighted [subcommand] →Cup your face in barely contained ecstasy.

name: Divine Arm
description: →Send forth radiant light from the Divine Artifact upon your arm.

name: Divine Disk
description: →Send forth radiant light from the Divine Artifact around your neck.

name: Divine Tiara
description: →Send forth radiant light from the Divine Artifact atop your head.

name: Stomp
description: →Vent your anger and frustration upon the ground beneath you with a well-placed stomp.

name: Facepalm
description: →Bury your head into your hands in frustration.

name: Clutch Head
description: →Seize your head in pain or anguish.

name: Pose of the Unbound
description: ALIASES: /poseoftheunbound, /unbound USAGE: /poseoftheunbound [subcommand] →Pose as if freed from all inhibition and common sense.

name: Hand Over
description: →Extend your hand in a giving gesture.

name: Doze
description: →Start dozing off. If a bed is nearby, your character will sleep in it.

name: Air Quotes
description: →Make air quotes with your fingers for added sarcasm, emphasis, etc. No system message is displayed with this emote.

name: Eastern Stretch
description: ALIASES: /easternstretch, /estretch USAGE: /estretch [subcommand] →Stretch your muscles in the Far Eastern fashion.

name: Water Flip
description: →Perform a somersault underwater. No system message is displayed with this emote.

name: Elucidate
description: →Explain yourself to any who will listen.

name: Crimson Lotus
description: →Practice the art of the crimson lotus.

name: Little Ladies' Dance
description: ALIASES: /littleladiesdance, /ladance USAGE: /ladance [subcommand] →Perform the Little Ladies' Dance.

name: Insist
description: →Speak emphatically to get your point across.

name: Break Fast
description: ALIASES: /breakfast, /bread USAGE: /bread [subcommand] →Chow down on a piece of bread.

name: Eat Pizza
description: ALIASES: /eatpizza, /pizza USAGE: /eatpizza [subcommand] →Snack on a slice of pizza.

name: Eat Egg
description: ALIASES: /eategg, /egg USAGE: /eategg [subcommand] →Casually eat a boiled egg.

name: Eat Pumpkin Cookie
description: ALIASES: /eatpumpkincookie, /cookie USAGE: /eatpumpkincookie [subcommand] →Nibble on a pumpkin cookie.

name: Eat Chicken
description: →Snack on a piece of fried chicken.

name: Drink Green Tea
description: ALIASES: /drinkgreentea, /greentea USAGE: /drinkgreentea [subcommand] →Sip at a soothing cup of green tea.

name: Lominsan Sip
description: →Take a brief draught from a decorative mug of mulled Lominsan punch.

name: Gridanian Sip
description: →Take a brief draught from a decorative mug of mulled Gridanian punch.

name: Ul'dahn Sip
description: →Take a brief draught from a decorative mug of mulled Ul'dahn punch.

name: Consider
description: ALIASES: /consider, /hmm USAGE: /consider [subcommand] →Mull over a curious question.

name: High Five
description: ALIASES: /highfive, /hifive USAGE: /highfive [subcommand] →Give someone a high five.

name: Advent of Light
description: →Soar to the heavens, then make a suitably heroic landing.

name: Photograph
description: →Take out your instant camera and snap a photo.

name: Twirl
description: →Merrily spin around to flaunt your currently equipped attire.

name: Blown Away
description: →Be hurled backwards by a great force.

name: Magitype
description: →Conjure a convenient terminal for all your recordkeeping needs.

name: Navigate
description: ALIASES: /navigate, /checkmap USAGE: /navigate [subcommand] →Get your bearings by consulting a map.

name: Red Ranger Pose A
description: ALIASES: /redrangerposea, /rrpa USAGE: /rrpa [subcommand] →Do the Red Ranger pose A.

name: Red Ranger Pose B
description: ALIASES: /redrangerposeb, /rrpb USAGE: /rrpb [subcommand] →Do the Red Ranger pose B.

name: Black Ranger Pose A
description: ALIASES: /blackrangerposea, /brpa USAGE: /brpa [subcommand] →Do the Black Ranger pose A.

name: Black Ranger Pose B
description: ALIASES: /blackrangerposeb, /brpb USAGE: /brpb [subcommand] →Do the Black Ranger pose B.

name: Yellow Ranger Pose A
description: ALIASES: /yellowrangerposea, /yrpa USAGE: /yrpa [subcommand] →Do the Yellow Ranger pose A.

name: Yellow Ranger Pose B
description: ALIASES: /yellowrangerposeb, /yrpb USAGE: /yrpb [subcommand] →Do the Yellow Ranger pose B.

name: Eastern Dance
description: ALIASES: /easterndance, /edance USAGE: /edance [subcommand] →Perform a Far Eastern dance.

name: Cheer On: Blue
description: ALIASES: /cheeronblue, /cheerob USAGE: /cheeronblue [subcommand] →Wave your hands enthusiastically with blue illuminated rods.

name: Cheer On: Bright
description: ALIASES: /cheeronbright, /cheerow USAGE: /cheeronbright [subcommand] →Wave your hands enthusiastically with white illuminated rods.

name: Cheer On: Orange
description: ALIASES: /cheeronorange, /cheeroo USAGE: /cheeronorange [subcommand] →Wave your hands enthusiastically with orange illuminated rods.

name: Cheer Wave: Yellow
description: ALIASES: /cheerwaveyellow, /cheerwy USAGE: /cheerwaveyellow [subcommand] →Wave your hand in the air with a yellow illuminated rod.

name: Cheer Wave: Violet
description: ALIASES: /cheerwaveviolet, /cheerwv USAGE: /cheerwaveviolet [subcommand] →Wave your hand in the air with a violet illuminated rod.

name: Cheer Wave: Pink
description: ALIASES: /cheerwavepink, /cheerwp USAGE: /cheerwavepink [subcommand] →Wave your hand in the air with a pink illuminated rod.

name: Cheer Jump: Red
description: ALIASES: /cheerjumpred, /cheerjr USAGE: /cheerjumpred [subcommand] →Jump and cheer enthusiastically with red illuminated rods.

name: Cheer Jump: Green
description: ALIASES: /cheerjumpgreen, /cheerjg USAGE: /cheerjumpgreen [subcommand] →Jump and cheer enthusiastically with green illuminated rods.

name: Cheer Jump: Indigo
description: ALIASES: /cheerjumpindigo, /cheerji USAGE: /cheerjumpindigo [subcommand] →Jump and cheer enthusiastically with indigo illuminated rods.

name: Cheer Rhythm: Red
description: ALIASES: /cheerrhythmred, /cheerrr USAGE: /cheerrhythmred [subcommand] →Keep the beat enthusiastically with red illuminated rods.

name: Cheer Rhythm: Violet
description: ALIASES: /cheerrhythmviolet, /cheerrv USAGE: /cheerrhythmviolet [subcommand] →Keep the beat enthusiastically with violet illuminated rods.

name: Cheer Rhythm: Bright
description: ALIASES: /cheerrhythmbright, /cheerrw USAGE: /cheerrhythmbright [subcommand] →Keep the beat enthusiastically with white illuminated rods.

name: Cheer Light: Yellow
description: ALIASES: /cheerlightyellow, /cheerly USAGE: /cheerlightyellow [subcommand] →Sway gently from side to side with yellow illuminated rods.

name: Cheer Light: Blue
description: ALIASES: /cheerlightblue, /cheerlb USAGE: /cheerlightblue [subcommand] →Sway gently from side to side with blue illuminated rods.

name: Cheer Light: Green
description: ALIASES: /cheerlightgreen, /cheerlg USAGE: /cheerlightgreen [subcommand] →Sway gently from side to side with green illuminated rods.

name: Heel Toe
description: →Perform a slick heel toe dance step.

name: Hum
description: →Swing your arms and hum a merry tune.

name: Love Heart
description: ALIASES: /loveheart, /heart USAGE: /loveheart [subcommand] →Make a heart shape with your hands.

name: Cackle
description: →Erupt into a haughty cackle that will put all who hear it in their place.

name: Water Float
description: →Perform a back float in water. No system message is displayed with this emote.

name: Confirm
description: →Make sure that all is as it should be.

name: Scheme
description: →Spin a web of lies and deceit.

name: Reprimand
description: →Let that special someone know what's for.

name: Lean
description: →Lean back and get comfortable. No system message is displayed with this emote.

name: Dazed
description: →See stars as you stumble in a stupor.

name: Tomescroll
description: →Lovingly tap your tomestone in search of succor.

name: Carry Book
description: →Clasp a tome tight to your bosom.

name: Pen
description: →Scrawl down some notes with a quill pen.

name: Devour Taco
description: →Continuously chow down on a sizable taco.

name: Savor Tea
description: →Continuously sip at a cup of green tea while seated.

name: Lominsan Gulp
description: →Continuously sip at a serving of mulled Lominsan punch.

name: Gridanian Gulp
description: →Continuously sip at a serving of mulled Gridanian punch.

name: Ul'dahn Gulp
description: →Continuously sip at a serving of mulled Ul'dahn punch.

name: Conduct
description: →Confidently conduct whatever may be unfolding before you.

name: Sundering
description: ALIASES: /sundering, /exodus USAGE: /sundering [subcommand] →Perform Exodus and sunder the world.

name: Sit
description: ALIASES: /sit, /lounge USAGE: /sit →Assume a sitting position. Certain emotes have special sitting equivalents. Also sits your character in a chair if the chair is nearby.

name: Sit on Ground
description: →Assume a sitting position. Certain emotes have special sitting equivalents. Does not sit your character in a chair even if the chair is nearby.

name: Change Pose
description: ALIASES: /changepose, /cpose USAGE: /changepose →Assume the next pose in a series of idle stances.

name: Visor
description: →Open/close helm visor. This function can also be used to toggle on/off helms that light up. No system message is displayed with this emote.

name: Straight Face
description: ALIASES: /straightface, /straight USAGE: /straight [subcommand] →Restore your facial expression to a neutral state.

name: Wink (Right)
description: ALIASES: /rightwink, /wink USAGE: /rightwink [subcommand] →Perform the wink emote with your right eye.

name: Wink (Left)
description: →Perform the wink emote with your left eye.

name: Pucker Up
description: →Close your eyes and pucker your lips.

name: Reflect
description: →Close your eyes and gather your thoughts.

name: Endure
description: →Grit your teeth and bear all that comes your way.
